card.name: Leading digit of numbers in dosing tables
card.fires_on: A single digit (often 1, 2, 3 or 4) that begins a number inside a dosing, dose-adjustment or dosimetry table, where the rest of the number follows right after it.

modes.label: Dose values in tables
modes.description: First digit of a dose or volume split from its decimal or following digits, in a table row.

modes.label: Age and weight ranges

modes.label: Dosimetry hours
modes.description: First digit of an hour or absorbed-dose figure in radiation dosimetry tables.

card.plain: It fires on the first digit of a number in a dosing or data table, just before the rest of the number.
